# raff_backup_schedule (Resource)

Manages a recurring backup schedule for a VM. (One-shot backups are imperative and not exposed as a Terraform resource — use the CLI's `raff backup create` for those.)



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `frequency` (String) Schedule frequency: daily or weekly.
- `keep_count` (Number) Number of backups to retain before auto-pruning.
- `time` (String) Time of day (e.g. 8am, 13:00).
- `vm_id` (String) Source VM UUID.

### Optional

- `day_of_week` (String) Day of week (Monday-Sunday). Required when frequency=weekly.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)
- `price_per_hour` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `runtime` (String)
